description: CRITICAL MACRO BUG FIX: Fixed macro button permanently disabled after first execution. Changed button state logic from '!isExecuting && !isCompleted' to '!isExecuting' enabling 'Run Again' functionality. Added enhanced console logging for button state debugging. STOP functionality already existed as 'Cancel Execution' button. Applied to both NVDA and SPY tabs via shared component. Passed comprehensive code review with zero issues.
